_about: Proxmox ember: the SERVER theme for pve-prod (VM 110 on pve). Dark warm-grey surfaces with the Proxmox orange (#e57000) as primary, so the accent, the zellij highlights and the Hyprland border are orange. primary also feeds ANSI green (color2) and nvim strings, so those render orange too. That is the accepted trade-off for a single-accent theme. primary_fixed_dim=blue, secondary=yellow, secondary_fixed_dim=magenta, tertiary_fixed_dim=cyan, error=red, as in macchiato.json.
